message.content:
ANSWER: YES

HALLUCINATIONS:
- Misstated Trigger Event/covenant sunset: The memo says the 7.00x cap lasts until the earlier of September 29, 2023 or completion/termination of the HHI Sale (and in the table, until 10 Business Days after closing/termination). The source defines the “Trigger Event” as the earliest of (i) September 29, 2023, (ii) 10 Business Days after the HHI ASPA Closing Date, or (iii) 10 Business Days after the Lead Borrower or its applicable Affiliates receive the “Termination Fee” under the HHI ASPA. There is no trigger based solely on “termination” (it is receipt of the termination fee), and the 10 Business Day delay applies. Additionally, the 7.00x threshold applies only prior to the fiscal quarter in which the Trigger Event occurs.

ANSWER: YES

MISSING_TERMS:
- Leverage covenant scope: applies to the Revolving Facility only.

{"has_issues": true, "issues": ["Leverage covenant relief end trigger is inconsistent: Executive Summary says the 7.00x maximum lasts until the earlier of September 29, 2023 or completion/termination of the HHI Sale, whereas the Key Deal Terms state it lasts until the earlier of September 29, 2023 or 10 Business Days after the HHI Sale closing/termination."]}
